# Watering schedule

In summer I water early in the morning, before the sun is high, directly at the foot of the plants and never over the leaves. A deep soak twice a week beats a daily sprinkle: roots go down looking for moisture instead of staying near the surface. Tomatoes get a litre each, courgettes two.

Rain barrels fill from the shed roof and cover about half the need. A thick mulch of straw keeps the soil from drying out. Containers are the exception and need water every day in a heatwave.

If the leaves droop in the evening but recover by morning, the plant is fine.
